correctness.rationale: Finite theorem with explicit 15-edge Kneser graph and exhaustive 32768 orientation masks; Kahn topological sort and independently implemented DFS edge-reversal test agree for every acyclic orientation. Full S5 permutation action enumerated, all orbit totals and degree invariance asserted. Every 9-edge subset checked for connected spanning-tree status, then all 2^9 orientations checked for all six chord path constraints; exactly 2000 trees and 540 coherent trees in five orbits. Cordovil–Forge Theorem 3 gives two orientations/tree, independently reproducing 1080 smooth points. An oriented tree incidence matrix is a basis of the saturated root lattice, so nine-valent fixed charts are smooth; nonsimplicial >9 degree fixed charts are not Q-factorial. CHECK.py returns VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: A geometrically natural, nontrivial complete local invariant for the toric ninefold of the canonical Petersen graph, with a sharp 1080/16680 smooth fixed-point fraction, complete distribution of non-Q-factorial fixed-point valencies, and exact S5 orbit decomposition. The five coherent-tree orbits are a structural refinement relevant to symmetry and degeneration studies, not a random threshold or routine restatement of global f-vector formulas. It is an exact motivated finite classification, with no unsupported claim of a general theorem or analytic singularity resolution.
